nameInUI: Smart threat reaction (only the targeted flight evades)
descriptionInUI: Only the flight a missile is actually guiding on goes defensive. Every other airplane stays on Passive Defense and keeps flying its route, where stock DCS breaks every jet that sees a launch. A flight facing a missile whose target DCS will not report flies straight instead of breaking. Helicopters keep stock behavior. Untick for stock DCS.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Off by default. On, every tagged shot prints to the screen for all players and every untagged shot is written to dcs.log -- useful for a test flight, unusable in a mission with an anti-ship salvo in it.
